newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close slightly lower.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed slightly lower on Friday as market liquidity loosened following Thursday's maturation of T$9.3 billion in government treasury bills, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 5.007 percent against Thursday's 5.039 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.20-5.25 against 5.25. Dealers expected the rates will continue their downtrend in the near term.
The bond market was quiet in the afternoon. The 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.6775-5.6800 against 5.6900-5.7050 in the morning trade. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
